$comment: The session baseline for the c track: the frozen implementation, rebuilt and re-measured on the machine running the loop. Regenerated by every session and committed so the site can say what the numbers were relative to. See docs/AUTORESEARCH.md.

runner.note: The speed axis is only comparable within a session. The baseline is rebuilt from source and re-measured every session for this reason; benchmarks/results.json was taken on a different machine and is not used.

grad_note: Measured on the seeded c candidate, which is the frozen track's source plus whatever accessors its probe needs. The frozen track carries no probe of its own, so this is the *frozen* tape's ratio, not the candidate's: 1.0051 for this port is docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md issue 5 -- an rmsnorm path that sits outside the tape -- and not an error in the measurement. The candidate on disk can and does differ, because the loop is allowed to fix it: the Rust candidate measures 1.0003, having put rmsnorm on the tape.
